# Load the dataset

# Set the visual style

scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Gender/Sleep Disorder', loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the visual style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep colored by Gender
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', 
                                style='Sleep Disorder', alpha=0.7, s=100)

# Customize the plot
scatter_plot.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender and Sleep Disorder', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Gender/Sleep Disorder', loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
